 Golden Bachelor Mel Owens & Peg Munson Break Up: ‘Focusing on Healing’ 
 Disney/John Fleenor 
 Sending love.
 Bachelor Nation watched Mel Owens search for love on Season 2 of “The Golden Bachelor.” 
 During the season finale, fans saw him hand out his final rose to Peg Munson and give her a ring as a symbol of his commitment.
 Since then, the two have kept followers updated with their lives online, often posting about their adventures as a couple. 
 But now, it has been revealed on social media that Mel and Peg have officially ended their relationship.
 In a new video posted online, Peg confirmed their breakup and stated that they’ve gone their separate ways.
 Instagram 
 She said, “As a lot of you guys know, I went on ‘The Golden Bachelor’ hoping to find love. And I did. And for that I’m grateful. I did have to make the difficult decision to step away from the relationship and sometimes even when there’s love, it just doesn’t turn out the way that we hoped.”
 Peg also reflected on their relationship and what’s next for her, sharing, “Right now, I’m just focusing on healing my heart and focusing on myself, my health, and looking forward to the next chapter. I really do wish Mel the best of luck and I’m very grateful for the experience and I’m grateful for the memories.”
 She also gave a note of gratitude for her followers and all the support she’s received over the past year. 
 “Thank you for standing beside me this past year. Your kindness means more than you know,” Peg stated. “This is not the end of my story. It’s the beginning of a new chapter.”
 We’re sending both Mel and Peg love as they navigate this next chapter, and we’re wishing them all the best.
